name: egg

phase_0.boundary_condition: The semi-permeable shell membrane and calcified exterior providing structural containment.

VINIT.justification: The quiescent state of potentiality before the initiation of metabolic development.

TANCH.justification: The terminal boundary where the internal system reaches completion and the vessel is discarded.

AFWD.justification: The directed transformation of nutrient stores into complex biological structures.

AREV.justification: The breakdown of stored lipids and proteins to fuel the forward growth morphism.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of enzymatic reactions required for cellular differentiation.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-recognition and copying of the genetic blueprint to maintain identity across cell divisions.

FSPLIT.justification: The physical division of a single zygote into distinct blastomere lineages.

FFUSE.justification: The integration of distinct cell layers into a single unified embryonic body.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state where biological markers meet the threshold for continued growth.

EVALF.justification: The failure state where lethal mutations or environmental stress terminate the process.

ENGAGR.justification: A state of suspended animation where the embryo is neither growing nor dead.

IFIX.justification: The permanent chemical fixation of gene expression patterns that cannot be undone.

phase_3.void_description: pre-ovulatory follicle before the assembly of the yolk and shell.
phase_3.true_description: active respiration and heartbeat within the shell environment.
phase_3.false_description: necrotic tissue or unfertilized decay within the shell.
phase_3.both_description: the transition point of the internal pip where the chick is both egg-bound and air-breathing.

steps.domain_action: the germinal disc exists in a state of uninitialized potential within the yolk.
the maternal genetic material identifies itself as the template for the system.
the shell is calcified around the contents creating a permanent physical record of the event.
fertilization triggers the first forward morphism toward cellular complexity.
the zygote undergoes the first cleavage into two distinct blastomeres.
the first division is successful and maintains chromosomal integrity.
the sequence of rapid mitotic divisions begins to form the blastula.
the embryo draws upon the yolk sac to reverse the entropy of its own assembly.
the system enters a period of temperature-dependent metabolic stasis.
the temperature drops below the threshold for viable enzymatic activity.
the disparate cell lineages converge during gastrulation to form the primitive streak.
the developing heart begins to beat recognizing its own rhythmic identity.
the skeletal structure begins to ossify fixing the body plan in a rigid form.
the chick moves into the final stage of organogenesis and feather development.
the beak pierces the air cell and the shell boundary is breached.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: ribosomal translation of mRNA into functional protein structures.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: hormonal signaling and calcium ion flux across cell membranes.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the genomic sequence stored within the chromatin of every cell.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the circadian rhythm and incubation temperature regulating developmental speed.
phase_5.alfs_store: the maternal mitochondrial DNA and cytoplasmic determinants.

phase_6.cycle_cost: chemical energy released from the oxidation of yolk lipids.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: high-energy nutrient stores and a single cell.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: low-energy waste products and a highly ordered multicellular organism.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the local decrease in embryonic entropy is balanced by the dissipation of yolk energy as heat.
